title: The AI Model That Refuses Nothing: GLM 5.2 Tested
description:
An open model that never says no 😅 SaferAI tested GLM 5.2 on cyber and bio tasks and it refused zero dangerous requests. Claude Opus blocked so much the CyberGym benchmark couldnt even finish. And GLM sits only few months behind GPT 5.6 and Gemini 3.1 on raw capability 🔥 Weights are public, you just need $30k of GPUs.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
